# New Domains

#### Chronos Domain

**Deity:** Deities of time and fate, denizens of the timestreams

**Granted Powers**

- **Erase From Time(Su):** As the oracle revelationUM.
- **Embrace The Alternates(Sp):** Starting at 8th level you can see across possible timelines increasing your accuracy, at the expense of diffusing the damage across the alternates. For any attack requiring a to hit roll you may roll twice and choose which one to keep. However, if you do hit, you only do 50% normal damage. On a confirmed critical you do full damage without critical modifiers as the alternate timelines momentarily synch.

**Domain Spells**
1st—true strike; 2nd—time shudderACG; 3rd—akashic communionMTT; 4th—sands of timeUM; 5th—permanency; 6th—age resistanceUM; 7th—lesser time stopBoDM; 8th—temporal stasis; 9th—time stop

#### Hedonism Domain

If it feels good, it’s never too much.

**Granted Powers**

- **Taste of Euphoria (Su):** As a standard action you may turn your breath into a fine mist which collects around a living creature you choose within 30 feet and granting it a feeling of heady elation. That creature receives a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1). You can use this power a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. You may expend 2 uses of this power to allow it to affect an undead with an intelligence score.
- **Bestow Intoxication (Sp):** Starting at 8th level, you can use confusion as a spell-like ability using your cleric level as the caster level. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

**Domain Spells**
1st—hypnotism; 2nd—enthrall; 3rd—deep slumber; 4th—air walk; 5th—feeblemind; 6th—mass suggestion; 7th—insanity; 8th—irresistible dance; 9th—etherealness

# New Subdomains

#### Chill Embrace (Death)

**Associated Domain:** Death.

**Replacement Powers:** You see death as a dignified slumber from which a creature should not be woken without cause. The following granted power replaces the bleeding touch power of the Death domain.

*Death’s Touch:* As a standard action, you can fire a black beam from your hand, targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. The beam deals 1d6 points of negative energy damage + 1 point for every two cleric levels you possess. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

**Replacement Domain Spells:** 1st—frostbiteUM, 4th—wall of ice, 7th—ice bodyUM

#### Continuum (Psionics)

Your powers bring you in tune with the majesty of the multiverse.

**Associated Domain:** Psionics.

**Replacement Powers:** The following granted power replaces the dispelling touch of the psionics domain.

**Planar Static (Ps):** You are able to interfere with the psionic abilities of creatures from beyond your plane of existence. Your may select two of the following types/subtypes to affect from the following: Fey, Outsider, deep one, elemental, or extraplanar. As a swift action creatures with the selected types are subject to a selective interference field (as catapsi) that lasts for 1 round per cleric level. You can choose a different pair of creature types with each use. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level and one additional time per day for every four cleric levels beyond 8th.

**Replacement Domain Spells:** 3rd—planar inquiry, 4th—planar adaptation, 5th—planeslayer’s call, 7th—plane shift

#### Contract (Law)

You carry the weight of lawful authority wherever you go and relish the pursuit of those who have broken their word.

**Associated Domain:** Law.

**Replacement Power:** The following granted power replaces the touch of law power of the law domain.

*Stern Condemnation (Su):* You can cause a creature to feel the dread of having made a grave transgression. Creatures touched take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1). You can use this ability for a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

**Replacement Domain Spells:** 2nd—zone of truth, 3rd—bestow curse, 5th—mark of justice, 7th—greater scrying, 9th—imprisonment.

#### Dimensions Subdomain (Travel)

**Associated Domain:** Travel

**Replacement Power:** The following granted powers replace the base speed increase and agile feet power of the Travel domain.

*Portal Sight (Su):* You can lay your hand upon any portal, gate, or stargate and see what is on the other side, as if using clairvoyance. Using this power takes 1 minute, during which time you must be touching the portal’s frame. You can keep looking for as long as 10 minutes with each use of this power, but must touch the surface and take no other action the entire time. You can use this power a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

*Anticipate Trouble (Su):* As a standard action, you can attune yourself to a portal or gate with a touch. Attunement lasts for 1 minute. If you pass through the portal within that time you gain an amount of temporary hit points equal to 1d4 + 1 for every 2 cleric levels you have. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

**Replacement Domain Spells:** 1st—cultural adaptationUI, 4th—lesser planar binding, 9th—gate

#### Stellar Subdomain (Travel)

**Associated Domain:** Travel

**Replacement Power:** The following granted power replaces the base speed increase and agile feet power of the Travel domain.

*Pilot's Precognition (Su):* The cleric gains + 2 on her ship’s base save, CMB, and CMD when piloting.

*Navigational Insight (Su):* When piloting the Sea of Stars a voyage between two planets within a solar system takes only 2d10 days, and a voyage to another star system takes 2d10 weeks.

**Replacement Domain Spells:** 1st—air bubble, 5th— greater track ship†, 6th—Kilroy’s adaptable skyship†
